About Wilmington Health

Since 1971, Wilmington Health has been committed to the care and health of our community in Wilmington as well as all of Southeastern North Carolina. Wilmington Health is structured as a multi-specialty medical practice with primary care providers integrated into the system. In this way, Wilmington Health is able to provide a comprehensive and coordinated approach to the care of all our patients. Wilmington Health is committed to using collaborative, evidence-based medicine in providing the highest quality of care to the patients we serve.

Purpose:

Wilmington Health is seeking a Business Intelligence/SQL Analyst to support data-driven decision making across the organization. This position requires proficiency in business intelligence and data tools to extract, transform, and analyze healthcare data. The Analyst is responsible for developing reports, identifying trends, and providing actionable insights to support strategic initiatives and operational improvements.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities:

• Analyze large data sets to determine appropriate logic to incorporate into existing processes to discover trends, relationships, and produce actionable insights to inform strategy, improve quality, and identify cost reduction opportunities.

• Create SSIS packages to extract, transform, and load large data sets.

• Develop efficient SQL procedures to support reporting.

• Develop, maintain, and enhance business intelligence reports, using Power BI, to visualize trends, KPIs, and operational metrics.

• Create and maintain documentation of all processes.

• Present thoughtful analytical summaries and findings to internal and external stakeholders.

• Assist with meetings, presentations, and communications regarding data projects and insights.

• Collaborate with clinical, operational, and IT stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions.

• Conduct ad hoc analyses of healthcare and/or business operational data.

• Maintain strict confidentiality and adhere to all data governance and compliance standards.

• Appear for work on time and attend meetings as required.

• Communicate professionally and appropriately with patients, physicians, coworkers, and external stakeholders

• Perform other duties specified by manager

**NOT open to Sponsorship at this time**

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

• Proficient in SQL coding, including the creation of stored procedures.

• Experience with SSIS for data loading and processing.

• Experience developing business intelligence reports; Power BI preferred.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Detail-oriented with the ability to handle multiple priorities.

• Effective and professional written and verbal communication skills.

• Proficient with MS Office applications.

• Familiarity with healthcare or health insurance data preferred.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required:

• Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

• 1+ years experience in SQL, SSIS, and Power BI

We are committed to treating everyone equally and with respect regardless of race, age, sex, religion, national origin, citizenship, marital status, veteran’s status, sexual preference, disability, genetic information, or any other class protected under state or federal law.

The Office of Information Services (OIS) is a shared service provider for the Oregon Health Authority (OHA) and Oregon Client (ODHS). OIS provides the technology systems and services that support more than 18,000 OHA and ODHS agency staff at local offices and facilities around the state. These systems and services help the two agencies determine client service program eligibility; provide medical, housing, food, and job assistance; provide addiction, mental health, vocational and rehabilitative services; protect children, seniors and people with physical and/or developmental disabilities; process claims and benefits; manage provider licensing and state hospital facilities; and promote and protect the state public health.
OIS/OHA are seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst/ Developer with expertise in SQL and Python programming to help modernize the ETL processes for a reporting data mart named HAL (Health Analytics Library). This work anticipates development and conversion of ETL pipelines, data tables and data processes and delivery of other HAL code updates in the current HAL on-premise environment, in which OHA currently ingests ETL data from the DSSURS data environment hosted in AWS cloud, but will also require continuity as OHA is preparing for the future migration of HAL to the OHA ODE (Oregon Data Environment) cloud Azure environment.
Contractor's Key Person under this WOC will closely with internal data management staff to identify scope of programming to update and update progress.
Contractor's Key Person will work with internal program staff to facilitate introductions with data owners and work team meetings.
Background and scope of project:
HAL is a Medicaid analytical and reporting SQL data mart solution and data environment managed by the MADI (Medicaid Analytics and Data Integration) Unit housed within the Office of Health Information Technology and Analytics Infrastructure, that exists within the Health Policy and Analytics (HPA) Division of the Oregon Health Authority (OHA).
Medicaid administrative data is primarily made up of 1) medical claims submitted by health providers and Coordinated Care Organizations (CCOs) to receive payment for health services delivered to patients enrolled in Oregon's Medicaid program, which is known as the Oregon Health Plan (OHP) and 2) Medicaid enrollment data from the OHA/ ODHS ONE eligibility system. The raw transactional data are stored in Oregon's Medicaid Management & Information System (MMIS). HA analysts typically access these data through a MMIS data warehouse solution called Decision Support and Surveillance Utilization Review System (DSSURS), or in the Health Analytics Library (HAL), where the raw Medicaid enrollment and utilization/ claim data are packaged differently into easier to analyze categories and groups for analysis. These analytical value-added elements are not present in DSSURS.
HAL contains Medicaid enrolment and claims data that is accessed by two main sets of users:
• OHA's Office of Actuarial and Financial Analysis (OAFA) team users, who use the data for setting of per-capita rates of reimbursement of health care services provided by Coordinated Care Organization (CCO's) to Oregon's Medicaid population, and various other financial analyses, and.
• Office of Health Analytics' reporting teams, who access Medicaid enrollment and claims data for the development of different enrollment and utilization analytical and data visualization products.
In 2025, the HPA MADI unit launched a HAL solution modernization project to convert the HAL ETL code from SAS to SQL, as well as to analyze, identify, develop, test and implement other improvements to the HAL data solution. This project has the following objectives:
• Reprogramming, testing and implementing HAL ETL code, currently written in legacy SAS language, into SQL/ Python language, to prepare HAL for receiving ETL data from the new DSSURS environment hosted in AWS and for the future migration of HAL to the OHA ODE (Oregon Data Environment) cloud Azure environment (NOTE: The migration to the ODE cloud, expected to occur in the next 1-2 years, is out of scope for this project and will require working with OIS and other OHA teams)
• Programming, testing and delivering other programming enhancements or programming work items related to HAL architecture, dataflows, tables, views, queries, reports, and ETL logic, including:
• Updating Medicaid claim data tables and reports used predominantly by the Office of Actuarial and Financial Analysis (OAFA) team for rate capitation analyses or to reflect updates in Medicaid national coding standards
• Performing other coding improvements needed by OAFA team users and other HAL users to improve analytical value and capabilities of HAL system data or to reflect changes in Medicaid eligibility, enrolment, benefits, programs, beneficiary and claim administrative coding- these types of improvements have accumulated over time and have reached a point in which they require a focused project and dedicated resources.

Tasks:
Contractor's Key Person shall
• Perform analysis of HAL data system as needed, which may include reviewing documentation and analyzing current HAL system/ environment, including data models, schemas and tables, data dictionaries, ETL's, system and database management processes, data quality, security, queries, reporting environment.
• Work with OHA project team members (PM, Client, DBAs, data analysts, architects), HAL management and HAL users to identify/ determine business/technical requirements.
• Gather and document detailed system, data and integration requirements for HAL system improvements (e.g. changes to ETL code, business rules, HAL tables, new or updated OHG Medicaid claim code grouping categories, etc.)
• Design, develop and implement data pipelines using ETL processes and SQL tables that extract, transform, and load data into a HAL Medicaid data system/ datamart that helps the organization reach its strategic goals..
• Migrate existing ETL process built in legacy SAS coding to Microsoft Structured Query Language ("SQL”) stack and Python language/ stored procedures, by:
• Working with various program areas and business teams to make code as modular as possible.
• Reviewing and analyzing existing ETL SAS programming code to update to new SQL/ Python language/ procedures
• Developing new SQL stack / stored procedures programming code to create new ETL processes.
• Test, troubleshoot and implement the new ETL code in the HAL test and production environments.
Required skills and experience:
• SQL programming language
• Python programming language
• Advanced data analysis skills.
• Experience using Microsoft DevOps, GIT or other code management tools.
• In addition, the ideal candidate will have skills and experience in:
• SAS programming language
• Experience using Jupyter Notebooks
• Data Warehousing
• Good communication skills

About the Team/Role
The Business Intelligence Analyst 2 will balance their time between providing wide analytics support to multiple lines of business and providing dedicated support for our largest and most complex strategic partnerships within the North American Fleet line of business.
The Analyst will dive deep into complex business challenges, utilizing data from internal and external sources to provide clear, actionable insights for decision-makers. This role will involve more than just collecting data; it will require identifying hidden patterns and trends within datasets to understand the underlying factors that influence business performance.

The Analyst will use this knowledge, combined with a strong understanding of the market, to construct accurate forecasts, develop insightful recommendations, and contribute to strategic and tactical planning. They will translate complex data into digestible reports and analyses, tailoring their approach to meet specific business needs and utilizing available data elements effectively. Beyond simply presenting data, the Analyst will act as a consultant, providing guidance to business partners and collaborating with cross-functional teams to solve pressing business problems. They will also possess the technical skills to generate datasets and reports using system reporting tools, ensuring the organization has the information it needs to succeed.

How you'll make an impact
The successful candidate will be pro-active and creative, with an insatiable curiosity and desire to understand not only what has transpired, but why. They will enjoy inspiring others by delivering actionable insights and will always think and act in our strategic partners’ best interest. Traveling to present at strategic offsite meetings may be required.

ANALYSIS & REPORTING:
• Utilize enterprise data platforms, Business Intelligence platforms and data visualization tools for data discovery and storytelling. Preferred experience in Snowflake, Tableau and Business Objects.

• Create and maintain datasets, dashboards and proprietary systems in support of analytical duties.

• Development and deployment of dashboards, trend analysis, operational reporting to key stakeholder groups.

• Develop both custom and ad-hoc reports as necessary to identify, illustrate, and monitor trends and issues within the portfolios for both the US and Canada.

• Perform ongoing analysis of data, changes, trends and other relevant patterns.

• Analyze industry trends and provide competitive benchmarking.

• Conduct self-directed investigations into data irregularities and proactively identify opportunities for service improvement and potential system issues.

• Fulfill all prioritized departmental ad hoc report requests from the Sales and Marketing teams.

• Provide insight and direction to the “Four A’s” of portfolio analysis and reporting: Acquisition, Approval, Activation and Attrition.

• Forecast portfolio volume against contractual obligations on a monthly basis.

COLLABORATION & QUALITY ASSURANCE:
• Partner with Service Delivery leadership to identify both broad and individual coaching needs, make recommendations based on data analysis, and develop and maintain a system for tracking and reporting out results to stakeholders on a recurring basis.

• Collaborate with Management to explore, evaluate and initiate revenue enhancement opportunities, program/product enhancements, and process improvements.

• Partner cross-functionally to strategically leverage relationships with Sales, Operations, Marketing, Product, IT and Finance.

Experience you'll bring
• 2 years experience in a relevant industry or a reporting and analytics role

• BS or MS degree in relevant area (Sales and Marketing, Data Analytics, Data Science) or commensurate experience

• Technical proficiency in SQL/PSQL, enterprise BI tools (Prefer Business Objects) and visualization tools (Prefer Tableau)

• A curious, forward-thinking mindset, with the ability to experiment with AI integration to transform how we interpret data and deliver value.

• Firm grasp of sales, marketing and B2B go-to-market strategies

• Ability to translate data-driven analyses into actionable insights and recommendations and effectively communicate these findings to the business and our customers.

Who We Are

Having surpassed $300M ARR and continuing to grow, Optro is the leading audit, risk, ESG, and InfoSec platform on the market. More than 50% of the Fortune 500, including 7 of the Fortune 10, leverage our award-winning technology to move their businesses forward with greater clarity and agility. And our customers love us: Optro is top-rated on G2.com and Gartner Peer Insights.

At Optro, we inspire each other to innovate and are proud of what we are producing. We spend each day thinking of new ways to help our customers and contribute to the greater good of our company and our surrounding communities. We are all about assisting each other and breaking through barriers to create the most loved audit, risk, ESG, and InfoSec platform by our customers. This is how we have become one of the 500 fastest-growing tech companies in North America for the seventh year in a row, as ranked by Deloitte!

Why This Role is Exciting

We are seeking a flexible and highly collaborative Training & Enablement Specialist for a 6-Month Contract to lead the educational and adoption strategy for our modern data and analytics ecosystem. As we migrate from our legacy systems (Power BI on Postgres/Azure) to our next-generation stack (Sigma Computing on Snowflake), your mission is to ensure our internal teams and customers are not only transitioned but empowered to thrive in the new environment.

This role is a unique blend of a BI Specialist, a Product Analyst, and an Educator. You will be responsible for demystifying complex data concepts, establishing best-in-class reporting standards, and acting as the bridge between technical engineering and end-user success.

Key Responsibilities

•
Training & Content Development

•
Material Creation: Design and produce comprehensive training and enablement materials, including technical documentation, video walkthroughs, and step-by-step 'How-To' guides.

•
Evergreen Process: Develop and manage a lifecycle process to ensure all training materials remain accurate and up-to-date as the migration evolves and new features are released.

•
Curriculum Leadership: Lead structured training sessions for different cohorts, ranging from executive stakeholders to power users and data analysts.

•
Data Literacy & Mentorship

•
Technical Coaching: Act as a subject matter expert to teach internal resources about data and BI best practices. This includes practical instruction on data modeling, relationship logic (how data joins work), and efficient query structures.

•
Product Analyst Lens: Evaluate user needs to determine how the new BI platform can best solve specific business problems, providing proactive recommendations on data structure and visualization.

•
Customer Engagement & Support

•
Office Hours: Lead regular 'Office Hours' sessions to provide a forum for customers to ask questions, troubleshoot specific reporting challenges, and receive live coaching.

•
Informational Sessions: Conduct webinars and informational workshops for customers to showcase the benefits of the modern stack and provide updates on the migration roadmap.

•
Feedback Loop: Collect and synthesize user feedback to share with the Data Engineering and Product teams to influence the future state of our analytics tools.

Attributes for a Successful Candidate

•
Experience: 3+ years in Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, or Technical Training. Proven experience with BI migrations is highly preferred.

•
Technical Skills: Proficient in SQL and experienced with modern BI tools (Sigma preferred; Power BI, Tableau, or Looker experience is applicable).

•
Data Foundations: Understanding of data warehousing concepts (Snowflake) and data model architecture (joins, schemas, and modeling).

•
Communication: Exceptional ability to explain complex, technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

•
Empathy & Patience: A passion for teaching others and a service-oriented mindset toward customer success.

•
Tools: Familiarity with version control and documentation management is a plus.

•
Experience teaching research concepts or data analysis in a business or academic context is a strong bonus.

Perks (United States, Temp)

•
Launch a career at one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in North America and EMEA!

•
Medical, dental, and vision coverage

•
Accrued vacation (non-exempt)

•
Time off for your birthday & volunteering

•
Employee resource groups

• perks may vary based on eligibility/location

Our Company Values

•
Customer obsession: It starts and ends here. Consistently ask yourself how what you’re doing creates value for our customers. It’s a mindset.

•
Gritty resilience: Make it happen. Find a way. Move fast, stay positive, and do what it takes.

•
Drive innovation: Create the future. Continuously improve what exists and invent what’s next.

•
Win, together: One team. No silos, no egos. Drive to be the best and support each other’s success.

•
Growth mindset: 10x, not 10%. Think in orders of magnitude, not increments. Seek feedback, learn, and improve.
